name: abilities-mcp
description: Connect AI clients to WordPress through the Abilities API. One-click bridge to your site's content, users, plugins, and Fluent ecosystem.
long_description:
Abilities MCP is the open-source bridge that turns a WordPress site into a first-class MCP server. This bundle uses a WordPress URL, username and Application Password for its App Password baseline, then can be upgraded to OAuth. Your AI client gets typed access to the abilities that the site exposes.

Use Mycelium for WordPress as the paired site setup. The legacy standalone alternative requires both `abilities-mcp-adapter` and `abilities-for-ai`; use that pair instead of, not alongside, Mycelium. The WordPress component exposes the MCP endpoint; this bundle is the client-side bridge running on your machine.

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your WordPress site URL, e.g. https://example.com

username.title: WordPress Username
username.description: The WordPress username the AI will act as. Capabilities of this user determine what abilities are available.

app_password.title: Application Password
app_password.description: WordPress Application Password (Users → Profile → Application Passwords). Stored encrypted in your OS keychain.
